name: ses-lockdown
description: Tether Secure Browser v1.6.0 (binds Secure Client Attestation v2 installation-bound signing into real exam sessions: attestExamSession now signs the secure-client session ID, secure-client capabilities snapshot, and a timestamp alongside the existing exam/submission/policy-hash facts, verified server-side against a full 20-point checklist before a SecureClientSession can receive v2-verified status. Compatibility governed by TETHER_EXAM_ATTESTATION_MODE=LEGACY|DUAL|V2_REQUIRED, safe default LEGACY. v1.4.0 and v1.5.0 were development-only, never distributed.)
